name: Callana
source:
The term, living under a rock can't be anymore stated. She was born into slavery and forced to work with hardly any education while being called a monster and a raven. That is when she met Misery. Depending on the path, she can give in her unknown hatred to the knights and kill them or spare them and escape the Kingdom.

She is surprisingly quick to learn not just attacks, but other subjects like simple language and math skills.
